repositories.name: axios
repositories.selectionBasis: proven graph-capable in the 2026-08-20 larger study

repositories.name: h3
repositories.selectionBasis: proven graph-capable; best performer in the small-batch report

repositories.name: zod
repositories.selectionBasis: NEW - single-package TS library, deep/nested source tree (locales/, v3/, v4/ style subdirectories), medium-to-large test suite, narrow PATH mapping expected

repositories.name: execa
repositories.selectionBasis: NEW - single-package TS library, shallow source tree, small test suite - structural counterpoint to zod's depth

repositories.name: trpc
repositories.selectionBasis: NEW - TS monorepo (pnpm workspaces), likely tsconfig project references, broad PATH mapping expected, larger test suite - diversity target for monorepo structure

repositories.name: vitest
repositories.selectionBasis: NEW - TS monorepo (packages/*), likely project references, different GH Actions structure (matrix testing expected) - second monorepo diversity target

repositories.name: defu
repositories.selectionBasis: BACKUP - tiny single-package TS utility, minimal test suite; only used if a primary candidate is excluded

repositories.name: react-router
repositories.selectionBasis: BACKUP - large TS monorepo, broad PATH mapping expected; only used if a primary candidate is excluded
